Figure Friendly Brownies!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Sunday, February 28, 2010 - 12:18pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
3/4 cup cocoa powder (example – Nestle or Hershey)
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
2 eggs
1/2 cup applesauce
1 cup low fat vanilla yogurt
2 teaspoons vanilla
1/2 cup chocolate chips
1/2 cup chopped walnuts or almonds
Powdered sugar for dusting

Preparation

1 Preheat oven 350 degrees: 2 Butter two – 8x8 baking pans and set aside. 3 In a large bowl combine the sugar, cocoa, all-purpose flour and baking powder. 4 In another large bowl, beat the eggs.  Slowly stir in the applesauce, yogurt and vanilla.  Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and beat with an electric mixer.  Fold in the nuts and chocolate chips. 5 Pour batter into the prepared pans and bake for about 30 minutes or until the batter just begins to pull away from the sides of the pan. 6 Let cool and then sprinkle with powdered sugar.

About


These brownies are a treat for you and your figure.
Enjoy with Love,
Catherine
